findings.title: Admin menu creation has no cumulative resource limit
findings.description: A compromised or malicious administrator can repeatedly create menu items. Each valid request adds both a menu_items row and an audit_logs row, while the route has no per-admin mutation throttle or per-restaurant item quota.
findings.mitigation: The route requires a current ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role, uses a same-origin BFF, limits request bodies to 32 KiB, validates all fields, and writes each mutation and audit record atomically.
findings.recommendation: Add server-side per-admin mutation throttling and a configurable maximum active and total menu-item count per restaurant.
